200.description: Status and mastery level per itemId of the current catalog.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches username or display name, ignoring case.

next.description: At least 8 characters for students, 16 for other roles.

groups.description: Items per taxonomic group for the current q/learnable/group filters, ignoring taxon.

reviewTargets.description: Ignored for account students: the server picks due items in review mode.

limit.description: Account students, review mode: how many due items the server picks.

progress.description: Account students only: review rows this answer touched, read after the write.

result.description: Present only after this question was submitted.

nextReviewInDays.description: Null for invite-code sessions, skipped entries and items without a schedule.

total.description: Graded entries (a matching question counts once per pair).

due.description: Active review rows whose effective due date is now or earlier.

activeSessionId.description: Latest unexpired session of this login that still has unanswered questions.

password.description: At least 8 characters for student, 16 for every other role.
At least 8 characters. Blank: the server generates one and forces a change.

dryRun.description: Only check format and duplicates: nothing is created and no password returned.

temporaryPassword.description: Only for a generated password on a real run; shown once, never stored in clear.

disabled.description: true locks the account and revokes its sessions; false unlocks it.

temporaryPassword.description: Shown once; never stored or logged in clear.
